advice.sow_now: Adequate profile moisture available (≥ 75 mm in last 7 days). Optimal window to sow crop.
advice.wait_for_soaking_rain: Profile moisture insufficient. Wait for at least 75 mm cumulative rainfall before sowing.
advice.prepare_land: Pre-sowing window. Complete summer tillage and keep seeds/fertilizers ready.
advice.contingency_short_duration: Normal sowing window has ended. Adopt short-duration contingency crops or intercropping.
advice.weed_management: Soil moisture is favourable. Maintain timely weeding to minimize moisture competition.
advice.mulching: Dry spell developing. Apply organic mulch or dust mulching (shallow interculture) to conserve soil water.
advice.foliar_spray: Moisture stress detected. Spray 2% potassium chloride (KCl) or 2% urea to alleviate drought stress.
advice.protective_irrigation: Apply life-saving protective irrigation (20-30 mm) using available protective water.
advice.no_calendar: No state crop calendar configured for this location. Consult local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).
advice.agronomist_disclaimer: ⚠️ Advisory generated based on ICAR-CRIDA dryland guidelines. Text and thresholds flagged for agronomic review by local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).
